test_discrete_equal: test that two Discrete objects with the same n and name are equal
test_discrete_not_equal: test that Discrete objects with different n or name are not equal
create_discrete_instance: create a Discrete space instance with a given n and name
test_discrete_type_inequality: test that a Discrete object is not equal to a non-Discrete type
run_discrete_tests: run the discrete space equality and inequality test suite
